item.description:

Is Moorabbin Expensive?

Moorabbin is one of Melbourne’s more affordable options — especially considering what you get for your money. It won’t stay this cheap forever.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Moorabbin, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.

item.title: Moorabbin Neighbourhood Guide — Streets and Pockets
item.description:

See our full Moorabbin suburb guide for the overview.

Moorabbin Isn’t Just One Thing
